scope: Finite unchanged-original client TallGrass inherited harvest: 68 complete singleplayer controller calls and six nullable-Player direct calls, in genuine prepared World/Chunk/Player/Stack owners.

original_capture.runtime: OpenJDK Temurin17.0.17+10 x64; interpreted, verified, headless,512MB heap.

limits: Arranged original method invocations, not original full client input, pixels/audio, save/reload, server behavior or complete game parity.
Only target CHANGE and ItemINSERT listeners are recorded. Other original listener methods still execute with the declared ordinary-return observer.
Explicit World/Math seeds are authored inputs. Default Entity Random constructor entropy, clocks, identities and unselected fields are not compared.
Cold class-initialization failures and unrestricted host/JDK/VM or malformed native storage behavior are outside this corpus.
The nullable statistic, writer and Player controls describe actual reached source exceptions and prior effects; native allocation/admission/refusal controls have separate scope.

The six NULL-Player direct calls are supplemental exception-prefix observations, not additional native direct-entry replay. Direct RU drop-ID calls have a different Random prefix and are not counted here.
